{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT: Create a premium static portfolio website for a charity coworking space called \"KindDesk Collective\". This is NOT an app, no backend, no login, no dashboard, no database, no API, no payments, no live booking system. It should be a beautifully designed static front-end website that can run with mock/sample content only. Goal: showcase the coworking space, its social mission, impact stories, spaces, partners, and community programs in a portfolio/marketing style. Tech preference: React static site, use GSAP for animations and scroll interactions. Overall visual style: glassmorphism, soft gradients, translucent cards, blurred panels, modern charity + creative coworking vibe. Reference mood: Instagram profile aesthetic / social feed layout, with square cards, story highlight circles, clean captions, warm community photos placeholders, but do not integrate Instagram API or real embeds. Just design a static Instagram-inspired section. BRANDING: Name: KindDesk Collective. Tagline: \"Workspaces that give back.\" Color palette: warm ivory background, translucent white glass cards, coral pink accents, emerald green charity accents, deep navy typography, subtle gold highlights. Typography should feel premium and human: big editorial serif headings + clean sans body. DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: fully responsive mobile/tablet/desktop, polished spacing, rounded glass cards, subtle shadows, frosted blur, layered gradient blobs, accessibility-friendly contrast, smooth hover states. Use GSAP animations: hero text reveal, floating glass cards, scroll-triggered section reveals, animated counters using mock numbers, horizontal gallery movement, staggered community cards, subtle parallax background shapes. Keep performance reasonable, no WebGL, no Three.js, no canvas game stuff. SITE STRUCTURE: 1) Sticky transparent glass navbar with logo text, nav links: Mission, Spaces, Impact, Stories, Programs, Gallery, Contact. CTA button: \"Visit the Space\". On scroll navbar becomes slightly more opaque. 2) HERO SECTION: full viewport hero with large headline: \"A coworking space built for creators, nonprofits, and neighbors.\" Subtitle: \"KindDesk Collective turns flexible desks, studios, and meeting rooms into funding for local education and housing projects.\" CTA buttons: \"Explore the Space\" and \"See Our Impact\". Include layered glass stat cards floating around the hero: \"42 community events\", \"18 sponsored desks\", \"$86k donated\", \"900+ volunteer hours\" using mock data. Background should have soft blurred photo placeholder area, gradient mesh, and glass reflections. 3) MISSION SECTION: split layout with frosted panel explaining how the charity model works. Include 3 glass cards: \"Book a desk\", \"Support a cause\", \"Build community\". Add micro icons using simple CSS/emoji/lucide style icons ok. 4) PORTFOLIO SHOWCASE SECTION: show coworking areas like a portfolio project grid. Cards: Sunlit Open Desk Hall, Quiet Focus Pods, Community Workshop Room, Podcast Nook, Nonprofit Meeting Lounge, Rooftop Volunteer Terrace. Each card should have mock image placeholder, category pill, short description, capacity, and impact note. Cards animate in with GSAP stagger. 5) IMPACT NUMBERS SECTION: large glassmorphism statistics block with animated counters. Mock numbers only. Metrics: 250+ members supported, 64 free nonprofit bookings, 31 local partners, 12 scholarship creators, 86k donated. Add note: \"Sample annual impact figures for presentation.\" 6) INSTAGRAM-INSPIRED COMMUNITY FEED: static section that looks like a curated social profile/feed. Header with circular avatar logo, handle @kinddeskcollective, bio text, follower-style stats but clearly static. Story highlight circles: Events, Desks, Donors, Workshops, Volunteers, Wins. Grid of 9 square cards with image placeholders and short captions overlay on hover, e.g. \"Saturday skill-share\", \"Donation wall\", \"Quiet pod mornings\". Do NOT use Instagram embed/API. It is only a visual reference. 7) PROGRAMS SECTION: glass tabs or cards for programs: Sponsored Desk Fund, Nonprofit Fridays, Youth Design Lab, Founder Office Hours, Community Meal & Workday, Skill Swap Nights. Since static only, tabs can be client-side UI state or simple clickable cards, no database. Include sample descriptions and CTA chips. 8) FEATURED STORIES SECTION: editorial cards with mock stories of fictional members. Examples: \"Maya launched a tutoring nonprofit from Desk 12\", \"A local design studio donated 40 mentor hours\", \"Weekend volunteers converted meetings into meals\". Include portrait placeholders and quote styling. 9) MEMBERSHIP / DONATION-STYLE OPTIONS SECTION: Not real payment. Static pricing/support cards only. Cards: Day Pass $18, Community Desk $120/mo, Team Room $380/mo, Sponsor a Seat $50/mo. Add label: \"Display only — static concept, no checkout.\" CTA buttons can be anchors like \"Ask about this\". 10) EVENT TIMELINE SECTION: upcoming community events with sample dates only. Vertical timeline in glass cards: Grant Writing Breakfast, Open Studio Friday, Volunteer Build Day, Nonprofit Pitch Night. Animated timeline reveal with GSAP. 11) PARTNERS WALL: logo placeholders in glass chips for fictional partners: GreenRoof Foods, BrightPath Tutors, Civic Loom, ShelterWorks, Open Pen Studio, GoodLoop Café. 12) CONTACT / VISIT SECTION: static contact block with address placeholder, hours, email placeholder, and a contact form UI that does not submit anywhere. Form fields: name, email, message, interest dropdown, but no backend. Add small text: \"Static demo form.\" Include a map-style decorative placeholder panel, not real map API. 13) FOOTER: mission statement, quick links, social-style icons, newsletter input UI as static only, copyright 2026 KindDesk Collective. INTERACTION DETAILS: GSAP ScrollTrigger for reveal animations, hero load timeline, smooth anchor scrolling, animated number counters, hover tilt effect can be CSS transform only, magnetic CTA feel if simple. Complex but still static. CONTENT STYLE: warm, optimistic, professional, charity-focused without looking childish. Use clear section headings, persuasive copy, and sample content. DELIVERABLE: complete responsive static front-end website. Prefer React components with clean structure: Navbar, Hero, Mission, SpacePortfolio, ImpactStats, SocialFeed, Programs, Stories, SupportCards, Timeline, Partners, Contact, Footer. CSS can be in one stylesheet or modules. Use placeholder images/gradients if real assets are unavailable. Must look polished like a high-end portfolio site for a nonprofit coworking brand.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
